opening.argument: The title and program presentation identify a televised interview and election-news segment, not a deceptive participation scheme. It is explicitly presented as “Frankly Speaking with Narendra Modi - Full Interview,” with discussion of election-related political issues and the battle with the Gandhis. The frames reinforce that context through the Times Now branding and the labels “FRANKLY SPEAKING” and “INDIA'S ELECTION NEWS HEADQUARTERS.” Any channel-subscription or app-promotion language is ordinary engagement material; nothing connects it to payment, investment returns, credential requests, or deceptive participation.
